description: This file is a shell script (.sh) that contains a series of tests and utility functions related to Git's partial clone functionality. It defines test cases for cloning, fetching, object validation, and repository configurations, mainly for verifying partial clone features and promisor objects in Git.

methods.name: delete_object
methods.description: Removes a specific object from a Git repository by deleting the corresponding file based on the SHA-1 hash.

methods.name: pack_as_from_promisor
methods.description: Creates a packfile from a promisor remote for a given hash, marks it as promisor, and returns the hash.

methods.name: promise_and_delete
methods.description: Creates a tag pointing to a commit, packs the object as from promisor, then deletes the original object file, simulating missing objects promised by a remote.

methods.name: repack_and_check
methods.description: Repacks the repository, optionally expecting failure, then verifies specific objects exist after repacking.
